item.title: Inside the rise of Lexa Gates, New York rap's breakout star
item.description: New York breakout Lexa Gates is rewriting the rules of alternative hip-hop, blending sharp-tongued rap with soft, soulful melodies and hyper-online instinct.

item.title: Sløtface’s Haley Shea on returning to their DIY roots: “We’re taking it back to the way we did things in 2016”
item.description: Wholesome punk collective Sløtface are throwing it back to 2016. Not just posting nostalgic snaps on Instagram, they’re creatively liberated and returning to their DIY beginnings. We find out more about their next steps

item.title: Bibi Club's guide to Montreal
item.description: The Montreal local musicians pick their must-see restaurants, music venues, cafes and more in this creative's guide to the Quebec city

item.title: Hemlocke Springs on turning internet virality into a singular debut
item.description: North Carolina's Hemlocke Springs turned TikTok virality into something far more durable. Now, as she releases her debut album, she speaks to Annie Barber about religion, creative instinct, and why life on the road leaves her cold.

item.title: Maya Hawke announces fourth album ‘Maitreya Corso’ and releases lead single
item.description: Maya Hawke has just announced her upcoming fourth album 'Maitreya Corso' and released lead single Devil You Know. Listen here.

item.title: The women in punk – and the girl I was
item.description: In the summer of 1977, Caroline Collett found punk because of a boy – and stayed because of the women. From Caroline Coon and Vivienne Westwood to Poly Styrene and Patti Smith, this is a love letter to the people who rewrote what a girl could be.

item.title: Is Jehnny Beth's new music video her wildest output yet?
item.description: It stars Faith No More's Mike Patton and is inspired by Scorsese's Taxi Driver

item.title: Violet Grohl announces debut album 'Be Sweet To Me'
item.description: Violet Grohl's debut record will be released this spring and is influenced by 90s grunge and shoegaze

item.title: Beabadoobee makes an explosive return with ‘All I Did Was Dream Of You (feat. The Marías)’
item.description: Beabadoobee is back with a new single 'All I Did Was Dream Of You' featuring The Marías and it's a slice of 90s brilliance.

item.title: “I saw a version of myself I didn’t like” – Courtney Barnett on burnout, honesty and starting again
item.description: After burnout, self-doubt and a documentary that forced her to confront it all, Courtney Barnett returns with 'Creature of Habit' – a louder, looser, more self-assured record from an artist learning to trust herself again.

item.title: Charlotte Cornfield on new album ‘Hurts Like Hell’ and combining music and new motherhood
item.description: With a cast of indie heavyweights and a fresh perspective shaped by motherhood, Charlotte Cornfield trades autobiography for story-led songwriting on Hurts Like Hell – without losing the gut-punch lines that made her essential.

item.title: Sarah Julia announce debut album ‘The Fear That This is Real’ and release new single
item.description: Amsterdam-based sister duo Sarah Julia have announced their debut album, ‘The Fear That This is Real’ and shared new single 'Conversation'.

item.title: Celine Cairo releases touching new single ‘Woman’
item.description: ‘Woman’ is taken from Celine Cairo’s upcoming third album, ‘Panacea’, set for release this summer. Listen to the new song.
